title: A Multi-granularity Interaction Network for Relational Triple Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.26952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relational triple extraction identifies entity relations from raw sentences without depending on entity type information. The performance of traditional methods is seriously degenerated by ``unseen'' entities, because these methods can't build contextual dependencies relevant ``unseen'' entities. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing a multi-granularity interaction network that leverages word-word, entity-relation, and head-tail interactions to capture deep semantic dependencies. By incorporating multiple iterations, the multi-granularity interaction network is effective to refine the representations corresponding to head and tail entities. It enhances the global semantic features associated with relational triples, aiding in the remediation of triples that may have been overlooked or omitted in earlier steps. Strong and consistent performance is achieved by our method on two rearranged datasets, with a significant improvement

translated_title: 面向关系三元组抽取的多粒度交互网络
translated_abstract: 关系三元组抽取旨在不依赖实体类型信息的情况下，从原始句子中识别实体之间的关系。传统方法在面对“未见过”的实体时性能会严重退化，因为这些方法无法构建与“未见过”实体相关的上下文依赖关系。本文通过提出一种多粒度交互网络来应对这一挑战，该网络利用词与词、实体与关系、头实体与尾实体之间的交互来捕捉深层语义依赖。通过引入多次迭代机制，多粒度交互网络能够有效精炼头实体和尾实体对应的表示，增强了与关系三元组相关的全局语义特征，有助于修复在早期步骤中可能被忽略或遗漏的三元组。该方法在两个重新整理的数据集上取得了强劲且一致的性能，并实现了显著提升。
tldr: 提出一种多粒度交互网络，通过词与词、实体与关系、头尾实体三种交互及多次迭代来捕捉深层语义依赖，显著提升了关系三元组抽取中对“未见过”实体的处理性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-granularity interaction network that leverages word-word, entity-relation, and head-tail interactions with multiple iterations to capture deep semantic dependencies, significantly improving relational triple extraction performance on unseen entities.
